title: Read type class operations
description: A type class specifies operations that a type supports. You can inspect those operations with :info.

steps.description: Num supplies arithmetic operations. Each displayed operation takes two values of type a and returns a value of that type.
Eq supplies equality and inequality tests. Both return Bool.
Supports conversion to a String. The examples convert a number, a Boolean value, and a list.
Ord supports ordering. compare reports an ordering result, while max selects the larger value.
